title: The scariest AI deepfake you have ever seen

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you ever see a video of your own face saying things you never said?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This AI deepfake is so realistic, it’s being used to spread misinformation faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a deepfake of a real CEO saying a company is bankrupt — made in just 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The AI uses voice cloning and facial mapping from just 30 seconds of video.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Lawmakers, journalists, and even family members are falling for it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? You can’t trust what you see online without verification.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you seen a deepfake that scared you? Let me know in the comments.
